newsitem.title: USA: BankAmerica stock gains on speculation of worker stock plan.
newsitem.headline: BankAmerica stock gains on speculation of worker stock plan.

text.p: The stock of BankAmerica Corp. rose Tuesday on speculation that it may announce a stock option plan for its 85,000 employees.
BankAmerica was up $1.375 to $97.375 in early trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
Earlier BankAmerica said that Chairman and Chief Executive David Coulter would make "a major, positive announcement affecting 85,000 employees worldwide" at 11:30 a.m. EST.
The company said the announcement would be made via a live satellite broadcast from San Francisco to BankAmerica employees in 26 locations in the United States and overseas.

Wall Street analyst George Salem at Gerard Klauer Mattison noted the bank's stock has been doing well recently, and he speculated that the announcement would be a stock option plan for all employees, something other banks have adopted.
